That demonstrates launch + browser + restart in the image. Not demonstrated: rewardkit actually invoking claude-code through OpenRouter and producing reward.json (no full configured judge run exists; index scope says so). Hence risk=true. Note (P3, template-controlled, not a task defect): base images are tag-pinned not digest-pinned and apt/--with-deps packages are unpinned; image history shows python:3.12-slim already resolves to Debian trixie while node comes from bookworm — works in the observed build but rebuilds can drift. A conforming alternative that could fail: one shelling out to the sqlite3 CLI (present in agent image, absent here) or using git at runtime — but integration.md limits apps to Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins, so that is out of contract, not a defect.
